title.before: I spot the problem, pitch the fix, and

hero.lead: I build client websites by day and my own products after hours, turning slow, manual processes into software that just works.

howIWork.title: Three things I do on purpose.

steps.title: Initiate
paragraphs: As an intern at WEG, I saw a better way to run the returns registry, pitched a demo to the whole branch and got the go-ahead to build it.
At Teclogix I brought in Planner and Figma. Both are now part of the team's daily workflow.

steps.title: Build
paragraphs: I build client websites full-time, and I built and launched a React site for a startup client in about a week.
After hours I'm building Budget Tracker, a full-stack budgeting app on Spring Boot, PostgreSQL and React Native.

steps.title: Live
paragraphs: Off the keyboard you'll find me on a hiking trail with my girlfriend, on guitar or piano, behind an espresso machine, or 3D printing a fix for something that broke.
